title: Mac mini personal server
snippet: Hi everyone, I have a Mac mini and was wanting to turn it into my personal server. Mainly for privacy reasons and also so I'm no longer tied to any particular ecosystem. I know absolutely nothing about self-hosting. I can do some technical stuff but was looking for something that I can just set up and then just works. Got the idea to do this after hearing about umbrel but I've heard mixed reviews and it doesn't work on Mac anyways. To start with I would like to be able to use it to backup and access all my photos and videos across all my devices no matter where I am and also have an AI agent/s running constantly. Over time I was hoping to have more and more stuff that I currently use cloud services for instead be ran by my personal server (eg. audiobooks, music, passwords, health data, map
